# Data Interface (Inputs)

Raw event parsing is not included (formats vary by device/platform).  
This repo focuses on **using event data** once you have preprocessed it into a consistent interface.

## Required per sequence
Data/<SEQ>/
  sae_frames/                 # REQUIRED: rendered event frames (png/jpg)
  ground_truth_speed.csv      # REQUIRED: speed profile for speed-bucket evaluation

## Generated by this repo
- `Data/<SEQ>/detections_topk.csv`
- `Data/<SEQ>_exp/kf_cv_topk/` (trajectory, metrics, overlays, plots)

## Notes
- Do NOT commit large raw data (events.txt, bag, videos).
